    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Action
    Represents a generic game action that can be executed by a player.
    AnimatedCard
    AnimateObject for cards.
    AnimatedObject
    This is a class that simplifies animating MeshViews, by holding a reference to both a Group containing the mesh and an invisible reference Rectangle object that gets updated by the JavaFX layout
    AnimatedTile
    AnimateObject for tiles
    AnimatedTotem
    AnimateObject for totems.
    Artist
    Represents the Artist character.
    At the end of the game, 10 prestige points are awarded every 2 Artists in the tribe.
    ArtistDTO
    Holds information about an Artist card in DTO format.
    Board
    Holds information about all elements present on the board.
    It contains a covered deck, a top and a bottom row of cards, an order tile and an offer path.
    BoardDTO
    Holds information about the current Board in DTO format.
    Builder
    Represents the Builder character.
    Each Builder reduces the food cost of every Building card and at the end of the game provides the stated prestige points.
    BuilderDTO
    Holds information about a Builder card in DTO format.
    Building
    Represents the Building card.
    BuildingDTO
    Simple data version of Building class (no logic)
    Card
    Defines the common methods of all Cards, which are either Characters, Buildings or Events.
    CardDTO
    Holds information about a Card in DTO format.
    CavePaintings
    During this Event, each player is awarded the amount of prestige points specified in the bottom row of the card if they own at least the indicated number of Artist cards in their tribe.
    CavePaintingsDTO
    Holds information about a CavePaintings card in DTO format.
    Character
    Represents common elements of all Characters.
    Each character can be an Artist, a Builder, a Gatherer, a Hunter, an Inventor or a Shaman.
    ChooseOfferAction
    Action that allows a player to select one of the available offers.
    ChooseOfferState
    Game state responsible for handling the "offer selection" phase.
    ChooseTotemAction
    Action that allows a player to choose a totem.
    ChooseTotemState
    Game state responsible for the "totem selection" phase.
    Client
    Represents the generic client interface used by the application to interact with the server, independently of the underlying communication protocol (TCP or RMI).

    This interface defines the core operations available to a player, including user authentication, game lifecycle management, action execution, server communication, and leaderboard retrieval.
    ClientCallBack
    Remote interface used for server → client communication in RMI.
    This interface defines callback methods that the server can invoke on the client to send updates, messages, and game state changes.
    Every method must throw RemoteException implicitly or explicitly, since it is executed over the network.
    ClientRMI
    RMI client implementation.
    This class acts as:
    Client-side proxy to communicate with the RMI server
    Remote callback endpoint (implements ClientCallBack)
    It receives updates from the server and forwards them to the UI layer via UIObserver.
    ClientTCP
    TCP client implementation for the game.
    This class handles all communication with the TCP server using:
    Synchronous request/response (via blocking queue)
    Asynchronous server updates (via listener thread)
    JSON serialization/deserialization using Jackson
    The client supports both:
    Game actions (create game, join, execute action, etc.)
    Server notifications (game updates, game closure)
    Controller
    Remote RMI interface exposed by the server.
    Defines all operations that a client can invoke remotely:
    - user authentication
    - game lifecycle management
    - gameplay actions
    - heartbeat mechanism
    - leaderboard retrieval
    All methods may throw RemoteException due to network communication.
    DBConnection
    Utility class responsible for managing the database connection and initializing the application database structure.
    This class creates the database and the required tables if they do not already exist.
    Deck
    Models a covered deck of cards.
    Decks can be shuffled and stacked.
    DrawCardFromBottomAction
    Action that allows a player to draw a card from the bottom row of the game board.
    DrawCardFromTopAction
    Action that allows a player to draw a card from the top row of the game board.
    DrawCardState
    Game state responsible for the card-drawing phase of a round.
    Effect
    Enumerates all possible Building effects.
    EndGameState
    Final game state responsible for computing results and rankings.
    EndTurnState
    Game state responsible for handling the end-of-turn phase.
    Era
    Enumerates the eras as roman numerals, which represent the current phase of the game.
    Event
    Represents common elements of all Events.
    Possible event subtypes can be CavePaintings, Hunt, ShamanicRitual and Sustenance.
    EventResult
    Contains information about the effect an event has had on a player's food and prestige points.
    The event is identified by its name and the card's id.
    FieldController
    JavaFX Controller for the field.fxml scene
    FillBoardState
    Game state responsible for refilling the board at the start of a new round.
    Game
    Represents a game session and manages its global state, including participating Players, the Board, the current turn, remote observers (RMI/TCP), and Event results.
    GameController
    Controller responsible for managing all active games on the server.
    GameDTO
    Holds information about the current state of the Game in DTO format.
    GameState
    Abstract base class representing a state in the game state machine.
    Gatherer
    Represents the Gatherer character.
    Gatherers provide a discount on the amount of food required during the Sustenance event.
    GathererDTO
    Holds information about a Gatherer card in DTO format.
    GUIApplication
    This class starts the GUI by loading the start-game.fxml scene and attaching it to the Stage
    GUIBuilder
    Utility class that generates dynamically some GUI components
    HelloApplication
     
    HelloController
     
    Hunt
    During this Event, each player is awarded 1 food token and the specified amount of prestige points for every Hunter in their tribe.
    HuntDTO
    Holds information about a Hunt card in DTO format.
    Hunter
    Represents the Hunter character.
    Each Hunter can have a food icon, in which case, when the card is drawn, the player is awarded 1 food token for each Hunter in their tribe.
    HunterDTO
    Holds information about a Hunter card in DTO format.
    Icon
    Enumerates the possible icons for Inventor cards.
    IllegalActionException
    This exception will be thrown whenever a player tries to execute an invalid or illegal action, which will be specified in its "reason" String.
    Inventor
    Represents an Inventor character.
    Each Inventor has an Icon.
    InventorDTO
    Holds information about an Inventor card in DTO format.
    JsonUtil
    Utility class for JSON serialization and deserialization.

    This class provides a shared Jackson ObjectMapper instance to convert Java objects to JSON strings and vice versa.

    It is used across the networking layer for TCP communication where messages are exchanged in JSON format.
    Launcher
     
    LeaderboardDTO
    Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to represent a leaderboard entry.
    This class stores information about:
    - The player's nickname;
    - The total score achieved;
    - The number of players involved in the match;

    It also supports JSON serialization/deserialization through Jackson annotations.
    Message
    Generic TCP message container used for client-server communication.

    Each message contains:
    - a RequestType identifying the operation
    - a JSON payload carrying the request/response data

    This design allows flexible and extensible protocol messages.
    ObserverTCP
    TCP observer interface used for server → client updates.

    This interface defines callback methods that the server uses to notify TCP clients about game state changes.
    Offer
    Represents an offer tile, where players' totems can be placed.
    Each offer tile allows players to draw a certain amount of cards from the top or bottom row, or can alternatively award food.
    OfferDTO
    Holds data about an Offer tile in DTO format.
    Order
    Represents the order tile, where the totems are placed at the start of a new turn, before being moved on the offer tiles.
    Each tile awards or deducts a certain amount of food and prestige points.
    OrderDTO
    Holds data about an Order tile in DTO format.
    Player
    Represents a player in the game.
    Each player has a name, a tribe composed by a list of character cards and a list of building cards, an amount of prestige points and food tokens.
    PlayerDTO
    Holds information about a Player in DTO format.
    RegisterPlayerAction
    Action used to register a player inside a game.
    RequestType
    Enum representing all possible TCP request types exchanged between client and server.

    Each value corresponds to a specific operation in the game protocol.
    Used for request routing / dispatching on the server side.
    ResolveEventsState
    Game state responsible for resolving all event cards at the end of a round.
    SaveGames
    Utility class used to manage game persistence.
    This class allows:
    Saving active games to a JSON file
    Removing saved games
    Loading saved games after a server restart
    Games are stored as GameDTO objects serialized through Jackson.
    ServerMain
    Entry point of the server application.

    This class is responsible for initializing the game controller, loading configuration parameters, restoring persisted data, and starting both RMI and TCP networking services.
    ServerRMI
    RMI server implementation.
    Responsibilities:
    - User authentication and registration
    - Managing RMI client callbacks
    - Game lifecycle management (create, join, leave)
    - Client heartbeat monitoring (ping-based timeout detection)
    Uses a GameController for game logic and a shared user map for persistence.
    ServerTCP
    TCP server entry point.

    Responsible for:
    - opening a ServerSocket
    - accepting incoming client connections
    - spawning a dedicated thread per client (ServerThread)

    This is a multi-threaded blocking TCP server model.
    ServerThread
    Handles a single TCP client connection.

    This class is responsible for:
    - Receiving and parsing client requests
    - Executing game operations through GameController
    - Sending responses back to the client
    - Managing user session state (login, join, disconnect)
    - Monitoring client timeout (heartbeat via ping)

    Each client runs on its own thread.
    SetupGameState
    Initial game state responsible for player registration and game initialization.
    Shaman
    Represents the Shaman character.
    Each Shaman has a certain number of star icons.
    ShamanDTO
    Holds information about a Shaman card in DTO format.
    ShamanicRitual
    During this Event, the player with the most star icons, provided by Shamans and possibly Building effects in their tribe, is awarded the specified amount of prestige points.
    ShamanicRitualDTO
    Holds information about a ShamanicRitual card in DTO format.
    SkipActionException
     
    SkipDrawAction
    Action that allows a player to skip the draw phase.
    StartGameAction
    Action that triggers the start of a game.
    StartGameController
    JavaFX Controller for the start-game.fxml scene
    StateDTO
    Enumeration of all possible game states in DTO form.
    Sustenance
    During this Event, players are required to pay 1 food token for each Character card in their tribe (Building cards do not count).
    SustenanceDTO
    Holds information about a Sustenance card in DTO format.
    Tile
    Logically links Offer and Order tiles.
    Totem
    Enumerates the available colors the players can choose for their totem.
    TUI
     
    UIMain
     
    UIObserver
    Observer interface used by the networking layer to notify the UI about changes in the game state or connection status.

    Implementations of this interface are responsible for updating the user interface when the server sends new game data, when a game session ends, or when the server becomes unreachable.
    UISession
     
    User
    Represents a user of the system identified by a nickname, with authentication data and session state information.

    A user can be active (logged in) and/or currently participating in a game session.
    UserDAO
    Data Access Object (DAO) for managing users and leaderboard data in the database.
    Provides methods to:
    - Load users from DB into memory
    - Insert new users
    - Insert leaderboard entries
    - Retrieve aggregated leaderboard data
